law_name: Law No. 15 of 2012 on the Protection of Copyright and Related Rights
orphan_works: Art. 48: Minister may grant a non-exclusive licence to copy or translate for public, educational or research needs if the owner refused or cannot be found after reasonable effort; fair pay to owner
notes: In force 22 July 2012 (Art. 91); 91 articles in 11 chapters; replaces the 1994 intellectual property law as to copyright.
